home.heroTagline: The space you live in, and the things you surround yourself with, directly influence your life
home.aboutBody: An architecture and interior design studio specializing in luxury residences. Every project is meticulously crafted around the client, the space and the light.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: The Studio
about.body: Talya Zaltsman is an experienced interior architect specializing in luxury residential design. Her studio focuses on creating restrained, refined spaces that combine authentic materials with precise detailing.
about.philosophy: We believe that great design is felt, not seen. Every choice — material, colour, proportion — stems from a deep understanding of the client and the space.

v1.title: Listening
v1.body: Every project begins with deeply listening to the client's needs and dreams

v2.title: Precision
v2.body: Every detail, every tone, every dimension — chosen intentionally and exactly

v3.title: Materiality
v3.body: We work with real materials that age beautifully with time

v4.title: Humanity
v4.body: The best space is one that feels like a home — not a museum

services.subtitle: What we offer
services.intro: Every project begins with listening. We understand your needs, analyse the space, and craft a solution that reflects your character.

architecture.title: Architectural Planning
architecture.body: Full residential planning, from concept to the smallest detail. We address spatial planning, flow and natural light.

interior.title: Interior Design
interior.body: Comprehensive design including materials, colors, furniture and lighting. Every element is carefully chosen to create complete harmony.

supervision.title: Project Supervision
supervision.body: End-to-end project management, from the first sketch to handover. Professional on-site presence to ensure quality and timeline.
